name: openpixo/sprite-idle-8dir
title: 8-direction idle animation
description: Step 2 of an idle animation: animates an 8-direction idle sheet into one calm breathing loop per direction, as transparent frames and an engine sprite sheet.

description_i18n.en: Step 2 of an idle animation: animates an 8-direction idle sheet into one calm breathing loop per direction, as transparent frames and an engine sprite sheet.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 待机动画第 2 步：把 8 方向待机姿势图做成每个方向一段平稳呼吸的循环，导出透明帧和引擎精灵图。

recipe.whenToUse: Second step of an 8-direction idle: animate an idle sheet from sprite-idle-sheet-8dir into a breathing loop for every direction.
recipe.prompt:
A 2D game sprite sheet on a flat green screen: eight copies of the same character in two rows of four, each standing in place and facing its own direction. Each copy plays a calm idle loop: it breathes slowly, its chest and shoulders rise and fall a little, its body bobs down and up by a few pixels, its hands hang relaxed and sway slightly, its hair and any loose cloth stir gently as if in a light breeze.

Every copy keeps both feet planted exactly where they are for the whole clip: no stepping, no walking, no shifting weight from foot to foot. No copy turns, leans, looks around or changes direction; each keeps facing exactly the way it faces at the start. Small, subtle motion only.

All eight breathe in sync. The clip starts and ends in the exact starting pose: one slow breath in and out.

Locked static camera, no zoom, no pan. Flat solid chroma-green background the whole time. Same design, colours and size in every frame. No new objects, no text, no shadows.
